question_text: Where a body link exists (from the T2.1.1 audit), in which direction does it run — soul/spirit expressing through the body, the body feeding back to the soul, or both — and what follows from that direction? If no body link, record none.

sample.text: **[CHAR-3]** E — The direction is consistently from inner constitutional condition outward to the body's expressive and receptive instruments. The lying lips (Pro 12:22 — VCG-02) express an inner character of deception — the inner condition flows to the lips. Wisdom's lips that find wickedness abominable (Pro 8:7 — VCG-02) express an inner moral faculty of revulsion outward through speech. The ear turned from the law (Pro 28:9 — VCG-03) is the volitional inner act of rejection expressed through the body's receptive faculty — but here a nuance: the ear's turning away from the law also functions as the mechanism through which the inner person is closed to divine instruction, so there is a secondary body-to-inner feedback: deliberate ear-closing reinforces the inner closure. The face-turning of Eze 14:6 (VCG-04) is directional — the face expresses the inner orientation's direction and is also the commanded instrument of volitional redirection.

**[CHAR-7]** E — **Inner to outer**: spirit/heart exults → tongue rejoices (Act 2:26); inner gladness → face smiles (Psa 39:13). The direction is consistently from the deepest constitutional level (spirit) outward through heart, tongue, and face. There is no evidence in this corpus of bodily state initiating the inner Suffering-Joy.

**[CHAR-3]** E — Primarily soul-to-body in consequence. The soul's covenantal betrayal (the will's volitional unfaithfulness — Num 5:20: "if you have defiled yourself... having lain with another man") produces a judgment received in the body (Num 5:27 — womb and thigh affected). The directional sequence is: volitional-covenantal betrayal (soul level) → defilement-state incurred (condition) → judicial consequence in body (body level). There is also a body-to-community movement: Eze 36:17 (VCG-04): "their ways before me were like the uncleanness of a woman in her menstrual impurity" — the bodily-impurity register (nid.dah) is the metaphor for the community's moral uncleanness, suggesting the body's impurity state provides the framework through which the corporate moral condition is understood (body informs the characterisation of the corporate soul-condition).

**[CHAR-2]** E — The body-link in VCG-02 runs in the *outer-to-outer* direction: the priest's body (finger, hands) acts upon the altar/sanctuary (external object). This is not a soul-expressing-through-body direction (as in CHAR-1's speech-mode sinning) but a body-as-instrument-of-remedy direction. For VCG-01's personal-moral register, the body direction evidence is minimal — eating with blood (1Sa 14:33/34) shows the body (mouth, eating) as the instrument of the inadvertent violation, running in the body-engaging-soul direction (the eating triggers a cultic violation whose moral reality the person did not register).

**[CHAR-13]** E — The direction is bidirectional. (1) *Body-outward generating the record*: the hands making idols (Isa 31:7), the mouth producing sinful speech (Psa 59:12) — body-to-record direction; the body's acts create entries in the divine record. (2) *Record-inward affecting the body*: Psa 38:3 — "no health in my bones because of my sin" — the record's weight produces physical deterioration; the divine record (held before God) produces bodily consequences. The direction thus flows both ways: body-acts → record-entry → physical-consequences → body-deterioration.

question_text: Where does this verse say the characteristic originates — generated within the person, received from another person, bestowed by God, carried generationally, introduced by another spirit (angelic or adversarial), or not stated?

sample.text: Inner closure has two origins evidenced in the cluster. Internal origin: the self-generated complacency of sha.a.nan (Amo 6:1 — "those who are at ease in Zion") and the self-declared wealth of Rev 3:17 — both are internally generated conditions produced by the person's own orientation toward their material prosperity. External-divine origin: Isa 6:10 names God as the agent who commissions the making-fat — "make the heart of this people fat" — in this case inner closure is externally imposed as judicial action. Both origins are present, representing different theological registers: self-generated complacency and divinely-imposed judicial hardening.

**[CHAR-1]** E — The origin evidence is multi-sourced. (1) *Internal — from within the will and heart*: Gen 39:9 (Joseph's description of the temptation as something he recognises as "great wickedness" — the sinful act originates in the responding will); Job 1:5 (sinning "in their hearts" — heart as origin site). (2) *External — received through temptation, pressure, or exposure*: 1Sa 15:24 ("I feared the people") — social pressure as external origin; Neh 13:26 (foreign women — relational exposure as origin); Neh 6:13 (enemies' trap — external manipulative pressure). (3) *Constitutional vulnerability in the creature*: 1Jo 1:10 ("if we say we have not sinned, we make him a liar") treats sinning as a condition from which no human is exempt — implying a constitutional susceptibility.

Mixed: distazō arises from external threat perceived (Mat 14:30 — the wind and waves, external); dipsuchos appears to be dispositional — the person is already double-minded, with no specific external trigger named in the verse evidence.

**[CLUSTER]** E — The cluster reveals two distinct constitutional origin patterns. All six locate their respective evil-forms as originating from within the person's own inner moral faculties — not received from outside or bestowed by God. However, five characteristics (Chars 1, 3, 4, 5, 6) show the origin as the person's own heart/will/mind operating incorrectly: Char 1 (Psa 36:1 — "transgression speaks in his heart"), Char 3 (Pro 11:20 — crooked heart), Char 4 (Eze 11:21 — heart going after idols), Char 5 (Isa 32:6 — heart busy with iniquity), Char 6 (Jude 8 — from within the authority-rejecting, dream-relying inner posture). Char 2 is the exception: Mat 7:11 ("you who are evil") presents constitutional inner evil as the baseline human condition — the origin is not a specific inner act but the fallen constitutional state from which specific evil expressions flow. The cluster's origin pattern: Char 2 names the fallen constitutional ground; Chars 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 name the specific inner-faculty expressions that arise from that ground.

**[CHAR-8]** E — Two constitutional origins are evidenced. (1) *External opportunity trigger*: 2Ki 1:1 / 3:5 — Moab's revolts originate when the governing authority is perceived as weakened (Ahab's death). The origin is in the political calculation of the revolting party assessing the governing authority's vulnerability. (2) *Inner spiritual abandonment of the governing authority*: 2Ch 21:10 — the origin is in Jehoram's forsaking of the Lord, which creates a spiritual-authority vacuum that enables revolt. The two origins represent different causal pathways: external political calculation vs the consequence of the governing authority's inner spiritual condition.

Chars 1 and 5 both show volitional choice + relational formation (chosen association) as dual originating conditions. Char 4 shows pride (Eze 7:20) + covetousness (Deu 7:25) + relational entanglement (1Ki 11:5) as multiple originating pathways. Char 3 shows multiple originating inner conditions (crooked heart, arrogant heart, lying lips, dishonest practice). Char 2 shows the fallen constitutional background as the universal enabling condition within which more specific evil expressions arise. Char 6 shows the authority-rejection + self-indulgence precondition (Jude 8) as the composite origin. The cluster's unanimous multiple-origin pattern confirms that M10b inner evil is not a simple causal phenomenon — it arises from the conjunction of constitutional susceptibility, volitional choice, and relational influence.
